title: Sheehan's Conjecture for Four-Regular Simple Graphs of Treewidth at Most Five
decided_scope: Every finite simple 4-regular Hamiltonian graph of treewidth at most five (and at most four) has at least two distinct undirected Hamiltonian cycles
open_boundaries: Unrestricted Sheehan's conjecture for 4-regular simple graphs of treewidth >= 6
